artifacts.input_scope: dental radiographs explicitly identified as xray
limitations: Confidence scores are model scores and are not calibrated probabilities.
Mask areas are image-plane measurements and are not physical units without acquisition calibration.
The pilot output is decision support and requires clinician review.

artifacts.runtime_block_reason: This checkpoint predicts COCO objects, not dental findings. It must be fine-tuned and validated on the dental COCO data before deployment.
